title: True Diamond Netherite
description: Transforms all Netherite armor into the classic Diamond look, while giving normal Diamond armor a darker contrast for easy identification.
body:
Tired of the dark Netherite look but still want the best stats? This resource pack brings back the nostalgia of the classic blue armor without losing your endgame progression!

What this pack changes:

💎 Netherite Armor: Fully re-textured to look exactly like the classic, vibrant Diamond armor.

🛡️ Normal Diamond Armor: Specially tweaked to be darker (navy/deep blue) so you can easily tell the difference between players wearing normal Diamond and players wearing "True Diamond" Netherite.

🐴 Horse Armor & Items: All corresponding items, including Netherite horse armor, have been updated to match the theme.

(PS: THIS PACK DOES NOT CHANGE WEAPONS, ARMORS ONLY)
